text:
Ms Samantha Bruin
Senior Nurse
Greywalls Nursing Home
27 Station Road, Greywalls

7/09/18

Dear Ms Bruin,

Re Mr Gerald Baker, 79 years old

Good day! I am writing to refer Mr Baker who is being  discharged today back into your nursing home. He undergone Left Total Hip Replacement due to his worsening osteoarthritis.

Post-operatively Mr Baker was disoriented on time and place maybe related to his anesthetic drugs prior to his surgery. He was given 3 units of packed red blood cells due to dropped of his hemoglobin during the operation which is now stabilized and requires continues monitoring. In addition to this, he was prescribed with aspirin 100mg, Ramipril 5mg and Panadeine Forte as needed for his pain. It was also noted that he can ambulate around the ward without difficulty with the help of wheelie-walker. 

Mr Baker needs monitoring of his prescriptions specifically Panadeine Forte. His operative site needs regular cleaning and dressing to avoid any infections however the staples on it will be removed in a couple of weeks. Also he has a follow up tests at the City Hospital Clinic. Please maintain the intactness of his skin with the help of his exercise program. The equipment needed for his program was already arranged by the social workers which will be provided by the local medical supplier

With the information mentioned above, if you have and queries please do not hesistate to contact me.

Sincerely, 

Nurse
